description: Exercises draft-pidlisnyi-aps-03 section 3.3's requirement that a verifier check revocation state for every chain member. A revoked ancestor (root, or a middle delegation) invalidates a root-to-leaf chain presented for a deeper descendant, even when no descendant delegation is itself revoked and no cascade or derived-revocation record exists for any descendant.

context.note: recorded_children is documentation only. It is never read by verify.ts or validate.py and must not influence the expected result. See README 'Vector 3' section.
